verdict.rationale: Pipedrive publishes an official Node.js API client under its own GitHub org, and the getting-started docs point to create-pipedrive-app, which scaffolds an app with the Pipedrive API client already wired up. It also ships OpenAPI 3 specs for both v1 and v2 APIs, which can be imported into other tools. Missing for 10: evidence of official SDKs beyond Node.js (e.g. Python, PHP), in-depth SDK documentation or v2 coverage details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
